title: Sometimes art is just not for you and that doesn’t mean it’s useless
transcript: You know what? I agree with Sweaty Oracle. You can hate a piece of art and it does not make you a bad person. You can hate a piece of art all you want. At the same time, there are two things that I undeniably believe to be true. One is that if we can critique art, then artists can critique us as critics. If we can let them know how art makes us feel, then they can let us know how our critiques make them feel. I think that's a fair trade. I also believe that if your hate relies on looking down or insulting anybody who doesn't share the same opinion, then you are an asshole. To put it bluntly, we consistently say that art is subjective. We can have different opinions. We can acknowledge where art fails us and give critiques on how to make art better, while also admitting that people can get enjoyment out of flawed art. And just because you didn't doesn't mean that anybody who did is inherently a lesser person. I also believe that hating on art that you don't personally enjoy is a great way to make art kind of monotonous.
